mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 10 degrees now, clear sky. Next 24 hours: high 11, low -1.

Houston police will no longer forward immigration violations to ICE, a policy shift announced three days after Democrats won the midterm elections.

The joint Macedonian-Bulgarian Historical and Educational Commission concluded its November meeting in Skopje without results and will reconvene in early December in Sofia.

U.S. Army Major General Stephen E. Osborn, the adjutant general of the National Guard, completed an official visit to Kosovo, meeting with the Kosovo Security Force and other commands.

Montenegro's President Jakov Milatović sent a congratulatory letter to Kosovo's President Justina Shiroka-Pula, saying bilateral reports will be deepened further.

A 60-year-old man from Gostivari has been sentenced to prison for allegedly forcing his 80-year-old mother, who uses a wheelchair, to beg on the streets and then taking the money.
